PostpartumRecovery.6: Umzimba wakho udinga isikhathi: yini ejwayelekile ngemva kokubeletha.
PostpartumRecovery.9: Izinsuku zokuqala: ukunciphisa isivinini nokuphila kabusha
PostpartumRecovery.19: Izinsuku zokuqala: ukunciphisa isivinini nokuphila kabusha
PostpartumRecovery.28: Isikhathi sangemva kokubeletha silandela ukubeletha. Asikhawulelwe ezinsukwini ezimbalwa: umzimba, indlela yansuku zonke nemizwa kungaqhubeka kushintsha kancane kancane emasontweni alandelayo.
PostpartumRecovery.29: I-“quarantaine” yisisho sendabuko esivame ukusetshenziswa ukuchaza amasonto okuqala okuphila kabusha. Singaba isikhumbuzo esihle: ngemva kokukhulelwa nokubeletha, kufanele unciphise isivinini unikeze umzimba isikhathi.
PostpartumRecovery.31: Ukuphila kabusha kuthinta umzimba, kodwa futhi nokulala, amandla, ukuhlelwa kwansuku zonke, nokujwayela kwemizwa esigabeni esisha sempilo.
PostpartumRecovery.32: Izinsuku zokuqala zingaba nzima. Ukuphumula, ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo nokujwayela indlela entsha kuvame ukuba yizinto eziza kuqala. Akudingeki ubuyele ngokushesha ezingeni lakho lamandla elijwayelekile.
PostpartumRecovery.34: Ukushintshanisa umsebenzi nokuphumula kusiza umzimba uphile kabusha kancane kancane.
PostpartumRecovery.36: Ukudla njalo nokuphuza ngokuya ngezidingo zakho kusekela ukuphila kabusha nsuku zonke.
PostpartumRecovery.38: Ukwamukela usizo kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukonga amandla okunakekelwa okubalulekile nokuphila kabusha.
PostpartumRecovery.40: Buyela kancane kancane ekunyakazeni nasemisebenzini, uhloniphe isimo sakho nokukhululeka kwakho.
PostpartumRecovery.41: Ukuphila kabusha kuhlukile kowesifazane ngamunye. Ezinye izinguquko zingaba yingxenye yesikhathi sokujwayela futhi zishintshe kancane kancane:
PostpartumRecovery.45: Amandla nobude bezimpawu kungahluka kumuntu nomuntu. Okubalulekile ukubuka ukuthi zishintsha kanjani futhi ucele ukweluleka uma ushintsho lubonakala lukukhathaza noma lungajwayelekile.
PostpartumRecovery.46: Ngesikhathi sangemva kokubeletha, imikhuba emincane nenokwenzeka imvamisa isiza kakhulu kunenqubo enzima. Inhloso ukusekela ukuphila kabusha ngaphandle kokwengeza ingcindezi.
PostpartumRecovery.47: Hlela izikhathi zangempela zokuphumula noma nini lapho kunokwenzeka.
PostpartumRecovery.48: Cela usizo ezintweni zansuku zonke nasekudleni.
PostpartumRecovery.49: Phuza njalo futhi udle ukudla okuhlukahlukene.
PostpartumRecovery.50: Gwema ukuqhathanisa ukuphila kwakho kabusha nokomunye umuntu.
PostpartumRecovery.51: Buyela emisebenzini kancane kancane, ngaphandle kokuzama ukwenza konke ngasikhathi sinye.
PostpartumRecovery.53: Ukuzungezwa ukusekelwa nokwamukela usizo akuyona into eyisithasiselo. Kungasiza ukulondoloza amandla futhi kwenze ukuphila kabusha kube kancane kancane.
PostpartumRecovery.54: Ukubuyela emisebenzini kungenzeka isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ngokuya ngokukhululeka, amandla, nezincomo ezitholwe ngemva kokubeletha. Ukunyakaza okuthambile nemisebenzi yansuku zonke kubalwa kakade njengokubuyela ekunyakazeni.
PostpartumRecovery.55: Ngemisebenzi enzima kakhulu, kungcono ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokweqa izinyathelo futhi ucabangele nanoma yiziphi izimpawu noma ukungakhululeki.
PostpartumRecovery.57: Ukungakhululeki okukhulayo ngesikhathi somsebenzi kuyisizathu sokunciphisa isivinini futhi, uma kudingeka, sokucela ukweluleka okufanele ngaphambi kokuqhubeka noma kokwandisa amandla.
PostpartumRecovery.58: Ukulala kungaba ngokungahleliwe ngemva kokubeletha. Ukukhathala okuqoqekile kungathinta amandla, ukuhlala unaka, nesimo sengqondo. Uma kunokwenzeka, ukwenza lula imisebenzi ethile nokwabelana ngezibopho kungasiza.
PostpartumRecovery.62: Ukuphila kabusha kancane kancane nokuqala kwemikhuba emisha.
PostpartumRecovery.64: Buyekeza inqubekela phambili yokuphila kabusha futhi nixoxe ngokubuyela emisebenzini kancane kancane.
PostpartumRecovery.65: Isikhathi sangemva kokubeletha singaletha imizwa eminingi: injabulo, ukukhathazeka, ukukhathala, ukuzwela, noma umuzwa wokuthwala kakhulu. Le mizwa ingashintsha ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi lapho ukulala nemikhuba yansuku zonke kushintsha.
PostpartumRecovery.66: Ukukhuluma nomuntu omethembayo noma nochwepheshe kungasiza uma imizwa isiba nzima ukuyiphatha noma ithatha isikhala esikhulu empilweni yansuku zonke.
PostpartumRecovery.68: Akudingeki ulinde uze ukhathale ngokuphelele noma uthwale kakhulu ukuze ukhulume ngendlela ozizwa ngayo futhi uthole ukusekelwa.
PostpartumRecovery.69: Ezinye izimo ziyafaneleka ukuxoxwa nochwepheshe wezempilo, ikakhulukazi uma ziba zimbi kakhulu, ziqhubeka, noma zibangela ukukhathazeka okukhulu.
PostpartumRecovery.71: Ubuhlungu noma ukungakhululeki okukhulayo esikhundleni sokuthuthuka kudinga ukweluleka kochwepheshe.
PostpartumRecovery.73: Ukopha okuba kukhulu ngokuzumayo noma okungajwayelekile kufanele kubikwe kochwepheshe wezempilo.
PostpartumRecovery.75: Uma ukudabuka kwemizwa kuthatha isikhala esikhulu noma kwenza impilo yansuku zonke ibe nzima, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngakho futhi ucele ukusekelwa.
PostpartumRecovery.77: Uma ungabaza ngokuphila kwakho kabusha, ukucela ukweluleka kukusiza uthole izincomo ezifanele isimo sakho.
PostpartumRecovery.78: Ukubonana ukulandelela kuyithuba lokuxoxa ngokuphila kabusha, izimpawu, ukubuyela emisebenzini, nanoma yimiphi imibuzo esele. Ukulungiselela imibuzo embalwa kusengaphambili kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho okukhohlwayo.
PostpartumRecovery.80: Ingabe ukuphila kwami kabusha kuqhubeka njengoba kulindelekile ngesimo sami?
PostpartumRecovery.81: Yiyiphi imisebenzi engingabuyela kuyo kancane kancane?
PostpartumRecovery.83: Ngingacabanga nini ngokubuyela ekuzivivinyeni okunamandla kakhulu?
PostpartumRecovery.84: Ngidinga yini noma yiziphi izeluleko ezikhethekile noma ukuvivinya?
PostpartumRecovery.85: Ukuphila kabusha ngemva kokubeletha kwenzeka kancane kancane futhi kuhlukile kumuntu ngamunye.
PostpartumRecovery.86: Ukuphumula nokusekelwa kungaba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kabusha.
PostpartumRecovery.87: Izinguquko zomzimba, ukulala nemizwa kungashintsha ngokuhamba kwamasonto.
PostpartumRecovery.88: Ukubuyela emisebenzini kancane kancane kukusiza uhloniphe kangcono amandla akho nokukhululeka kwakho.
PostpartumRecovery.89: Uma uphawula uphawu olungajwayelekile, oluqhubekayo, noma olukukhathazayo, ukucela ukweluleka kuyisinyathelo esihle.
PostpartumRecovery.91: Ukuphila kabusha akuyona umjaho. Ukuqhubeka kancane kancane, uhlonipha izidingo zakho futhi ucela ukusekelwa lapho kudingeka kuyizinyathelo ezibalulekile kakade.
PostpartumRecovery.92: Lesi sihloko siyolwazi kuphela futhi asithathi indawo yeseluleko sezokwelapha esenzelwe wena. Uma uphawula uphawu olukhulu, oluqhubekayo, noma olukukhathazayo, xhumana nochwepheshe wezempilo.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Kungani isalah iyamiswa ngalesi sikhathi, nokuthi ungaphila kanjani ngalesi sikhathi ngokuthula.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezenzelwe umuntu.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Akukho ukwenza kabusha amasalah angeniwe, ngokungafani nokuzila
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Ngesikhathi sesikhathi, isibopho sesalah siyamiswa: owesifazane akaphoqelekile ukuthandaza ngalesi sikhathi. Lokhu kumiswa kuyingxenye yomkhuba wenkolo ngokwawo, owamukelwe isikhathi eside isiko.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Lokhu kumiswa akusho ngandlela thile ukuzihlukanisa nokholo noma ukuyeka ukwenza inkolo. Kuyisiphuzo esamukelwe, okufanele siphiliswe ngaphandle kwecala: kuyingxenye yohlaka lwemvelo lwempilo yomoya yowesifazane.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Lesi sikhathi singabhekwa ngokuthula: asibuzi ngokubaluleka kokholo noma ukuhlala njalo kwenkolo yomuntu.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Uma isikhathi siqala ngesikhathi isalah iqhubeka, iyaphazamiseka: akudingeki iqedwe noma yenziwe kabusha. Ngokuphambene, uma isikhathi siphela, isalah iyaqhubeka ngokujwayelekile ngemva kwe-ghusl (ukugeza okukhulu), okukhombisa ukubuyela esimweni sokuhlanzeka kwenkolo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: Ngokungafani nokuzila kweRamadan, okuhlala kwenziwa kabusha izinsuku ezingaziliwe ngesikhathi sesikhathi (qadaa), amasalah angeniwe ngesizathu esifanayo ngokuvamile awenziwa kabusha ngemva kwalokho. Lokhu kuhlukana kuchazwa ubuhlobo bale misebenzi emibili yokukhonza: isalah wumsebenzi wansuku zonke ophindwa kaningi ngosuku, kanti ukuzila kungowonyaka futhi kugxile ngenyanga ethile.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Lokhu kuhlukana kungamangaza lapho umuntu eqala ukuthola i-fiqh. Akusho ukuthi isalah ibalulekile kancane: ukulandela isiphuzo njengoba sinikeziwe, ngokwaso, kuyingxenye ephelele yomkhuba wenkolo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Ukungathandazi ngesikhathi sesikhathi akusho ukuhlukaniswa nenkolo yakho yomoya. Izindlela eziningi zokukhonza nokubandakanyeka enkolweni ziyatholakala ngalesi sikhathi.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Ezinye izindlela zokukhonza, njengokufunda noma ukuphatha ngqo i-Quran, zingaba nemibono ehlukene ngokuya ngesikole se-fiqh. Ukubheka umbono ojwayele ukuwulandela, noma ukucela ukweluleka kwesazi esifanelekile, kusiza ukucacisa lezi zimo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Isalah emiswe ngesikhathi sesikhathi iyisiphuzo esamukelwe, okufanele siphiliswe ngaphandle kwecala. Izindlela eziningi zomoya ziyatholakala ngalesi sikhathi, futhi ukweluleka kwesazi esifanelekile kuhlala kuyisethenjwa kunoma yimuphi umbuzo othile.

PregnancyExercise.6: Ukuhlala unyakaza kancane, ngokuphepha, kuyo yonke i-trimester.
PregnancyExercise.13: Ukuhamba, ukubhukuda ne-yoga yabakhulelwe imvamisa kuyanconywa phakathi nokukhulelwa konke, ngesivinini esifana nendlela ozizwa ngayo.
PregnancyExercise.17: Gwema ezemidlalo ezinomthelela omkhulu noma imisebenzi enengozi yokuwa, ikakhulukazi kusukela ku-trimester yesibili:
PregnancyExercise.18: Ezemidlalo ezinomthelela omkhulu (ukugijima okunamandla, imidlalo ye-racquet esheshayo)
PregnancyExercise.19: Imisebenzi enengozi yokuwa (ukuskitsha, ukugibela amahhashi, ukugibela ibhayisikili endaweni enamagebe)
PregnancyExercise.21: Ukuzikhandla okukhulu endaweni ephakeme noma ekushiseni okukhulu
PregnancyExercise.23: Ubuhlungu, ukopha, noma ukuncipha kwesibeletho ngesikhathi sokuzikhandla
PregnancyExercise.25: Lalela njalo izimpawu zomzimba wakho futhi ukhulume nombelethisi wakho noma udokotela ngaphambi kokuqala noma ukushintsha umsebenzi wokuzivivinya.
PregnancyExercise.27: Umsebenzi othambile nowejwayelekile uyasiza ezimeni eziningi zokukhulelwa: okubalulekile ukuvumelanisa amandla nesigaba ngasinye nendlela ozizwa ngayo.

PregnancyWeekly.6: Izigaba ezibalulekile kusukela ku-trimester yokuqala kuya kweyesithathu, ukuze wazi okufanele ukulindele esigabeni ngasinye.
PregnancyWeekly.7: Ukukhulelwa ngakunye kulandela isivinini saso: lezi zinkomba ziyajwayelekile futhi zingahluka kowesifazane ngamunye.
PregnancyWeekly.16: I-trimester yokuqala ibeka izisekelo: wonke amaphethelo amakhulu ingane akhiwa kancane kancane. Futhi yisikhathi lapho ukukhathala nokucasuka kwesisu kuvamile, ngezinga elihluke kakhulu ngokuya ngowesifazane.
PregnancyWeekly.18: Lezi zimpawu, nakuba kwesinye isikhathi zingakhululekile, ziphawu zokuthi umzimba uzivumelanisa ngenkuthalo nokukhulelwa.
PregnancyWeekly.19: I-trimester yesibili imvamisa iyona ekhululekile kakhulu, kuvela ukunyakaza kwokuqala kwengane.
PregnancyWeekly.21: Imvamisa kuzwakala phakathi kwamasonto angu-18 nangu-22, kungaphambilana kancane uma lokhu kungekhona ukukhulelwa kwakho kokuqala.
PregnancyWeekly.22: I-trimester yesithathu ilungiselela umzimba ukubeletha, ngokukhula kwesisindo nokukhathala okubonakala kakhulu. Ukuncipha kokuzijwayeza (okuyaziwa ngokuthi i-Braxton Hicks) kungavela futhi.
PregnancyWeekly.23: Lokhu kuncipha imvamisa akuhleleki futhi akubuhlungu kakhulu; kuhlukile ekuncipheni kokuhelelwa.
PregnancyWeekly.28: Ukucasuka kwesisu nokukhathala, ikakhulukazi ku-trimester yokuqala
PregnancyWeekly.32: Izimpawu ezithile zidinga ukweluleka kwezokwelapha ngokushesha, noma iyiphi i-trimester:
PregnancyWeekly.36: Ikhanda elibuhlungu kakhulu noma izinkinga zamehlo
PregnancyWeekly.39: I-trimester ngayinye ilethe izinguquko zayo: ukuzazi kusengaphambili kukusiza uphile esigabeni ngasinye kangcono, ngaphandle kokuthatha indawo yokulandelelwa njalo nombelethisi wakho noma udokotela.

RamadanFasting.6: Amathiphu asebenzayo nezikhombisi zemfundo zokuphila inyanga yeRamadan usesikhathini, ngokuthula.
RamadanFasting.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezenzelwe umuntu.
RamadanFasting.14: Ngesikhathi sakho sesikhathi, ukuzila akuphoqelekile: lesi sikhathi sibeka owesifazane esimweni lapho izenzo eziningana zokukhonza, kuhlanganise nokuzila, ziyamiswa okwesikhashana. Lokhu kumiswa kwamukelwa njengesiphuzo, hhayi njengokwenqatshelwa noma isijeziso.
RamadanFasting.15: Ukumisa ukuzila ngesikhathi sakho sesikhathi akusho ukuhlehla enkolweni yakho. Kumiswa nje isikhathi esilinganiselwe, bese kuqhubeka ngokujwayelekile uma isikhathi sakho siphela, ngaphandle kokulahleka kwanoma yisiphi isenzo sokholo. Izinsuku ezingaziliwe ziyokwenziwa kabusha kamuva (qadaa), ngaphandle kweRamadan.
RamadanFasting.17: Lokhu kumiswa kungaphiliswa futhi njengesikhathi esihlukile enyangeni, lapho impilo yomoya iqhubeka ibonakala ngezinye izindlela, ngaphandle kokuzila.
RamadanFasting.19: Lesi simo akufanele siphiliswe ngecala: sisingxenye yomjikelezo wemvelo womzimba futhi sibhekwe isiko lenkolo ngokwalo.
RamadanFasting.20: Ukungazili akusho ukuhlukaniswa nenyanga yeRamadan. Izindlela eziningi zomoya ziyatholakala futhi zikuvumela ukuthi uqhubeke uphila ngokuphelele lesi sikhathi.
RamadanFasting.30: Lezi zenzo ezincane, noma ezilula, zikusiza uhlale uxhumene ngokuphelele nomoya wenyanga, noma ngabe sinjani isimo sakho.
RamadanFasting.31: Ukulandelela izinsuku zakho zesikhathi ngeRamadan kwenza kube lula ngemva kwalokho ukubala inani lezinsuku ezidingeka ukwenziwa kabusha (qadaa), futhi kugwema ukuthembela enkumbulweni inyanga isiphelile.
RamadanFasting.32: Bhala usuku ngalunye olungaziliwe njengoba kwenzeka
RamadanFasting.33: Sebenzisa ikhalenda, i-app, noma incwadi ezinikele
RamadanFasting.34: Yenza ukuhlola okusheshayo ekupheleni kwenyanga ukuze uqinisekise inani eliphelele
RamadanFasting.36: I-AWA ingakusiza ulandelele umjikelezo wakho phakathi neRamadan yonke, ukuze uthole lolu lwazi kalula kamuva.
RamadanFasting.38: Imigomo ethile yokwenza kabusha izinsuku ezingaziliwe (isikhathi, izimo ezikhethekile njengokukhulelwa noma ukuncelisa) ingahluka ngokuya ngesikole se-fiqh. Ngesimo esithile noma esinzima, umbono wesazi esifanelekile uhlala uyisethenjwa.
RamadanFasting.40: Ukuzila okumiswe ngesikhathi sakho sesikhathi kuyisiphuzo esamukelwe, hhayi ukuphumula enkolweni yakho. Ukuphila lesi sikhathi ngendlela ehlukile, ukulandelela izinsuku zakho, nokucela isiqondiso lapho ungabaza konke kukusiza udlule eRamadan ngokuthula.

RegularIrregularCycle.1:
Umjikelezo ohleliwe noma ongahleliwe:
kuhluke kanjani?
RegularIrregularCycle.4: Umjikelezo ngamunye wokuya esikhathini ukhethekile. Ukuqonda lokho okubhekwa “njengokujwayelekile” kungakusiza ulandelele impilo yakho kahle futhi ubone ukungalingani okungaba khona.
RegularIrregularCycle.11: Umjikelezo ubhekwa njengohleliwe uma ubude bawo buhluka phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-21 nangu-35, ngomehluko ongaphansi kwezinsuku ezi-7 kusuka emjikelezweni oya komunye.
RegularIrregularCycle.13: Okubalulekile kakhulu ukubuka ukuhamba kwakho phakathi nezinyanga.
RegularIrregularCycle.15: Owesifazane ngamunye uhlukile. Okubalulekile ukwazi ukuhamba kwakho nokuhluka kwakho okujwayelekile.
RegularIrregularCycle.16: Umjikelezo ubhekwa njengongahleliwe uma ubude bawo buhluka kaningi noma ngokungalindelekile (umehluko wezinsuku ezingaphezu kwezi-7). Lokhu kungabonakala njengemijikelezo emifushane kakhulu, emide kakhulu, noma ukungabi khona kwe-ovulation.
RegularIrregularCycle.18: Lokhu kuhluka kungaba okwesikhashana noma kuqhubeke imijikelezo eminingana.
RegularIrregularCycle.20: Ukungahleleki kwesikhashana kungaba okujwayelekile (ukucindezeleka, izinguquko zamahomoni, ukukhathala…). Kodwa uma kuqhubeka, kubalulekile ukucwaninga imbangela.
RegularIrregularCycle.24: Isisindo esiphansi kakhulu noma esiphezulu kakhulu
RegularIrregularCycle.26: Akukho sikhathi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezi-3 (ngaphandle kokukhulelwa/ukuncelisa)
RegularIrregularCycle.27: Imijikelezo emide kakhulu (ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezingu-90) noma emifushane kakhulu (ngaphansi kwezinsuku ezingu-21)
RegularIrregularCycle.30: Uma uzama ukukhulelwa futhi i-ovulation ibonakala ingekho
RegularIrregularCycle.36: Umjikelezo ohleliwe noma ongahleliwe: kuhluke kanjani? — AWA

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.6: Amaphuzu ambalwa esiqondiso somoya okusiza udlule ekulahlekelweni ngobumnene, ukubekezela nesihawu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo. Imibuzo ethile yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe nesazi esifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa enziwe umuntu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.15: Ukulahlekelwa ukukhulelwa kungaba isilingo esibuhlungu kakhulu. Ukudabuka, ukuthula, ukudideka, noma isidingo sokuhlehla kuyimiphumela yemvelo yomuntu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.16: Ukuzwa le mizwa akusho ukuswela ukholo. Owesifazane ngamunye angadlula ekudabukeni kwakhe ngesivinini sakhe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.20: Ngemva kokulahlekelwa, imithetho yenkolo ingancika esimweni nasohlotsheni lokopha.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.21: Ikakhulukazi, kungase kudingeke kuhlukaniswe phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokopha ngaphambi kokunquma ukuthi yimiphi imikhuba yenkolo okufanele ilandelwe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.27: Isimo somuntu siqu singadinga impendulo ehlukile. Kungcono ukucela ukweluleka komuntu ofanelekile.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Ukubekezela (sabr) akusho ukungakhali noma ukungezwa ubuhlungu. Kungaphelezela nje uhambo ngokholo nethemba.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Izenzo ezincane zingasiza ukubuyisa kancane kancane umuzwa wokuthula: ukuncenga, isikhathi se-dhikr, ukulalela okomoya, noma ubukhona bomuntu omthandayo.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.35: Ukuphola kuthatha isikhathi. Akukho sivinini sonke sokudlula ekulahlekelweni.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.37: Akudingeki wenze konke ngasikhathi sinye. Khetha okuhambisana nendlela ozizwa ngayo nalokho okukudingayo manje.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Gcina imikhuba emincane yomoya uma ikududuza
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Cela ukweluleka kunoma yimuphi umbuzo othile wenkolo
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.42: Cela ukusekelwa uma usizi seluba nzima ukulithwala
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.44: Ukuzinakekela, ukucela ukusekelwa, nokubamba ithemba kungasiza kancane kancane ukuqondisa indlela eya enkambisweni yokuthula.

ReligiousFaq.6: Imibuzo evame kakhulu mayelana ne-fiqh yabesifazane, eqoqwe endaweni eyodwa ngezimpendulo ezicacile.
ReligiousFaq.8: Lokhu okuqukethwe kungokwemfundo kuphela. Imibuzo yenkolo kufanele iqinisekiswe izazi ezifanelekile. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezenzelwe umuntu.
ReligiousFaq.14: Imibuzo eminingi mayelana nomjikelezo, isalah nokuzila ivela njalo kowesifazane oya komunye. Nazi izimpendulo ezijwayelekile ezemibuzo evame kakhulu; ukuze uqhubeke, isihloko ngasinye sihlanganiswe futhi ngokujulile esihlokweni saso esizinikele.
ReligiousFaq.16: I-fiqh yabesifazane ihlanganisa imithetho esebenzayo ethinta ngokukhethekile imizimba yabesifazane nokukhonza kwabo: umjikelezo, ukuhlanzeka, isalah, ukuzila, i-nifas ne-istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.17: Yiziphi izihloko eziyinhloko eziqukethwe yi-fiqh yabesifazane?
ReligiousFaq.18: Iqukethe ikakhulukazi isikhathi nomjikelezo, ukuhlanzeka kwenkolo, i-ghusl, isalah nokuzila ngesikhathi nangemva kwesikhathi, i-nifas, ne-istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.19: Kuhluke kanjani isikhathi, ukopha kwangemva kokubeletha, nokopha okungahleliwe?
ReligiousFaq.20: Isikhathi (hayd) silandela umjikelezo ojwayelekile, i-nifas yenzeka ngemva kokubeletha, kanti i-istihâda ikhomba ukopha okungahleliwe, ngaphandle komjikelezo. Ngayinye ilandela isimo esihlukile.
ReligiousFaq.22: Isalah iyamiswa ngalesi sikhathi: kuyisiphuzo esamukelwe, okufanele siphiliswe ngaphandle kwecala.
ReligiousFaq.24: Ukuzila nakho kuyamiswa; izinsuku ezingaziliwe ziyenziwa kabusha kamuva (qadaa), ngaphandle kweRamadan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Kungani amasalah angeniwe ngokuvamile engenziwa kabusha, ngokungafani nokuzila?
ReligiousFaq.26: Lokhu kuhlukana kubangelwa ubuhlobo bale misebenzi emibili: isalah ingeyansuku zonke futhi iyaphindwa, kanti ukuzila kungowonyaka futhi kugxile enyangeni eyodwa. Ukulandela isiphuzo kuyingxenye ephelele yomkhuba wenkolo.
ReligiousFaq.27: Isalah iqala nini kabusha ngemva kwesikhathi?
ReligiousFaq.28: Ngokushesha nje lapho isikhathi siphelile futhi i-ghusl senziwe, isalah iyaqhubeka ngokujwayelekile, ngaphandle kokulibaziseka.
ReligiousFaq.30: I-ghusl wukugeza okukhulu okuvumela umuntu ukuthi abuyele esimweni sokuhlanzeka kwenkolo esidingekayo ukuqala kabusha isalah nezinye izenzo zokukhonza.
ReligiousFaq.31: Kufanele wenzeni uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi isikhathi siphelile?
ReligiousFaq.32: Ukubona ukungabikho ngokuphelele kokopha isikhathi esanele, esikhundleni sokuthembela emibonweni yesikhashana, kusiza ukucacisa isimo.
ReligiousFaq.33: Ezinye izindlela zokukhonza zingenziwa ngesikhathi sesikhathi?
ReligiousFaq.34: Yebo: i-dhikr, ukuncenga, isisa, ukufunda ngenkolo, nezinye izenzo zomusa ziyatholakala.
ReligiousFaq.35: Kungani ezinye izimpendulo zingahluka ngokuya ngesimo?
ReligiousFaq.36: I-fiqh iyindawo yokuhumusha: imibono ingahluka ngokuya ngesikole se-fiqh nezimo zomuntu siqu, ngaphandle kokuba nombono owodwa ophelele ngokwawo.
ReligiousFaq.37: I-fiqh yamaSulumane ihlanganisa ukwahlukana okwamukelwe kokuhumusha emaphuzwini athile emininingwane. Lokhu kwahlukana kukhona amakhulu eminyaka futhi kubhekwa njengokusemthethweni esikweni lenkolo.
ReligiousFaq.38: Ngokuya ngomthombo obuzwayo, umbuzo ofanayo ngakho-ke ungathola izimpendulo ezihluke kancane. Lokhu akusho ukuthi impendulo izoba iphutha ngokuzenzakalelayo: kubonisa izindlela nokufunda okuhlukile kwemithombo efanayo.
ReligiousFaq.40: Ukulandela njalo umthombo ofanelekile, esikhundleni sokushintsha njalo umbono ngokuya ngempendulo etholakele, kusiza ukugcina umkhuba wakho ucacile futhi uthule.
ReligiousFaq.41: Ezinye izimo ziyahlala zinzima ukuzibeka ngokuya ngencazelo eyodwa jikelele. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi lapho:
ReligiousFaq.42: Kunokungaqiniseki ngokuthi isikhathi siphele nini ngempela
ReligiousFaq.43: Uhlobo lokopha lusahlala lungaqinisekile (isikhathi, i-istihâda, okunye)
ReligiousFaq.45: Umbuzo wokuqala kabusha isalah usahlala ungaqinisekile
ReligiousFaq.48: Uma isimo siwesomuntu siqu, esinzima, noma esiqhubekayo, asikwazi ukuxazululwa ngolwazi lukajikelele. Ukuya kwesazi esifanelekile, esikwazi ukucabangela isimo sakho esithile, kuhlala kuyindlela engcono kuleso simo. I-AWA ayikhiphi ama-fatwa noma izinqumo zenkolo ezenzelwe umuntu.
ReligiousFaq.49: I-fiqh yabesifazane ihlanganisa izici eziningi zomkhuba wenkolo wabesifazane
ReligiousFaq.50: Ezinye izinto ezincane zingahluka ngokufanele ngokuya ngesikole se-fiqh
ReligiousFaq.51: Ulwazi lukajikelele alathathi indawo yesiqondiso senkolo esenzelwe umuntu
ReligiousFaq.52: Ukungabaza okuqhubekayo kufanele kuphakanyiswe kwesazi esifanelekile
ReligiousFaq.54: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa ngokwe-fiqh yabesifazane — AWA
